decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpack types, ranging from ultralight hiking packs to everyday carry (EDC) bags. The Granite Gear Virga 2 (prod_backpacks_041) initially looked promising for hiking, but several reviews specifically mentioned the shoulder straps failing on the first trip, which is a major red flag for durability. The Hebetag hiking pack (prod_backpacks_101) had similar strap durability complaints. The Maxpedition bag (prod_backpacks_038) appears very durable but is significantly more expensive. Ultimately, I chose the HIKPRO 20L pack (prod_backpacks_006) because it has an exceptionally high rating (4.7) across a massive number of reviews (2872), providing a high degree of confidence in its quality for a very affordable price point, making it the most logical value-driven purchase.
